A savory dish despite its ingredients.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Monster Stews can be made by [[Cooking]] any [[Meat]], any [[Seafood]], and [[Monster Extract]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Their default version can be made either by using seafood without status effects, such as [[Hyrule Bass]]es or [[Sanke Carp]]s, or by using seafood with contradictory effects. The Monster Extract used in this recipe causes the amount of [[Heart]]s healed to [[Link]]'s [[Life Gauge]] to be random each time it is made. The same principle applies to the strength and duration of any status effects. These stews are known to be savory, despite the ingredients used. By using certain types of seafood or adding more ingredients, Link can create several variations of Monster Stew: * '''Chilly Monster Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Monster Stew}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Meat and seafood simmered in monster extract. A savory dish despite its ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Chillfin Trout]]s or other chilly ingredients. When eaten, these stews will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Monster Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Monster Stew}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Meat and seafood simmered in monster extract. A savory dish despite its ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Voltfin Trout]] or other electric ingredients. Eating these stews will grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Monster Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Monster Stew}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Meat and seafood simmered in monster extract. A savory dish despite its ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using enduring ingredients. When eaten, they will completely restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Energizing Monster Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Monster Stew}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Meat and seafood simmered in monster extract. A savory dish despite its ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Staminoka Bass]]es, [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s, or other energizing ingredients. Eating them will refill a part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Monster Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Monster Stew}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Meat and seafood simmered in monster extract. A savory dish despite its ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using hasty ingredients. Link can eat these stews to receive an increased movement speed. * '''Hearty Monster Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Monster Stew}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Meat and seafood simmered in monster extract. A savory dish despite its ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Bass]], [[Hearty Salmon]]s, [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]]s, or other hearty ingredients. These stews heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts when eaten. * '''Mighty Monster Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Monster Stew}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Meat and seafood simmered in monster extract. A savory dish despite its ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Carp]]s, [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]], [[Razorclaw Crab]]s, or other mighty ingredients. Link will gain a boost to his attack power if he eats them. * '''Sneaky Monster Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Monster Stew}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Meat and seafood simmered in monster extract. A savory dish despite its ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stealthfin Trout]]s, [[Sneaky River Snail]]s, or other sneaky ingredients. By eating them, Link's [[Stealth]] will be increased. * '''Spicy Monster Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Monster Stew}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Meat and seafood simmered in monster extract. A savory dish despite its ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sizzlefin Trout]]s or other spicy ingredients. They can be eaten to grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Monster Stew''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Monster Stew}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Meat and seafood simmered in monster extract. A savory dish despite its ingredients.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Armored Carp]]s, [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]], [[Ironshell Crab]]s, or other tough ingredients. Consuming these stews will increase Link's defense. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The recipe for Monster Stew is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Mystery Meal for the Merchant]]". It is made using six [[Raw Gourmet Meat]]s, six [[Razorclaw Crab]]s, and six [[Monster Extract]]s. However, it can be lowered to four of each ingredient through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Warrior]]s will have 50% less total [[Heart]]s and a 15% boost to all other stats. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Monster Stew Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Monster Stew ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood, Stews |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
